Saliency location entropy and effective attended fraction

Source: R/saliency_maps.R
saliency_location_entropy.Rd

Normalizes a heat map over all pixels, separately from edge weighting. A zero-mass map has unavailable features. Negative log densities are valid.

Usage

saliency_location_entropy(saliency, representation, signed_policy = "reject")

Arguments

saliency

Nonempty numeric matrix of aligned saliency values.

representation

Required: "weights" or "log_density" (natural logs).

signed_policy

For raw weights: "reject", "rectify", or "shift".

Value

A data frame containing H_location and KL_uniform in bits, effective_fraction = 2^-KL_uniform, and status.

Details

KL and effective fraction are invariant to equal-mass subdivision of every pixel. They are not invariant to arbitrary resampling or smoothing.

Examples

saliency_location_entropy(matrix(1, 8, 8), "weights")
#>   H_location KL_uniform effective_fraction status
#> 1          6          0                  1     ok
